global_guardrails: no betting decisions / picks / stakes / edges
no raw headers, cookies, tokens, API keys or secrets in reports
no fake success: missing data must be UNKNOWN or BLOCKED
no fallback provider IDs, scores, status, venue or roster values
public raw line table required after push
status may be fail-closed observation and still pass verifier

passes.objective: Create shared multisport kernel, sport profiles, provider capability matrix and fail-closed contracts.
required_gates: profile completeness for all seven sports

agent_must_not: promote docs-only provider to real proof
passes.objective: Capture/replay provider responses and build source-bound shadow artifacts per sport profile.
Create shadow-only activation candidates and bounded live/fail-closed observation reports per sport.
required_gates: live observation accepts fail-closed blocked outcome

passes.objective: Merge multisport foundation to main only after source-bound evidence, tests and public raw gates pass.
